rules.inputTick: Each step call advances one tick; frames are applied on that tick; input sequence contiguous; multiple FLAPs in one call apply one impulse.
rules.speed: For one-based active tick t, base=speed+floor((maxSpeed-speed)*clamp(t-1,0,rampTicks)/rampTicks); add floor(speed*floor(score/speedEveryPipes)*speedStepPercent/100), capped at maxSpeed. A score earned during this step affects the following step.
rules.canonical: Recursively sorted ASCII object keys; arrays preserve order; safe integers only; challenge metadata is included on generated default pipes and challenges:null is canonicalized as explicit null.

generation.gapSelection: center_i is clamp(raw_i, previousGap +/- maxGapDelta, configured bounds); legacy custom rules use seeded independent fmix32 samples. Default rules select four-pipe authored families by pipe index: intro block 0; seeded adjacent cruise families in blocks 1-2; then independently seeded pressure block 3, recovery block 4, alternating pressure/recovery indefinitely. Family selection does not consume the collectible RNG. Default challenge families: intro-steady [280,280,280,280]k; cruise-steady [280,280,280,280]k, cruise-rise [265,275,290,305]k, cruise-dip [295,285,270,255]k, cruise-offset [300,300,270,270]k; pressure-rise [280,230,190,270]k, pressure-dip [280,320,350,280]k, pressure-offset [280,330,300,220]k; recovery-steady [280,280,280,280]k. Shared gap height 156000 and spacing 300000; every selectable family boundary is validated against maxGapDelta 85000 and is not silently clamped.
generation.cursor: rng cursor advances by uint32(0x9e3779b9) for each generated pipe and each evaluated spawn opportunity, including NONE and capacity suppression

rules.spawn: Filter eligibility/spacing, cumulative half-open NONE-first buckets; total zero after filtering means NONE; one opportunity per pipe. Existing items move once; newly spawned items stay aligned with their post-movement pipe. Capacity suppresses spawn without retry.
rules.ordering: input/integration/world move; lethal collision; if alive score ordered pipes; generate; spawn opportunities in pipe order; collect in stored array order; cleanup. Lethal tick does not move/collect items or generate.
rules.configIdentity: dd-v1-stepped-v1 iff config content equals current DEFAULT_CONFIG. Otherwise dd-v1-config: followed by canonical JSON of {configuration,patterns}. No hash collision and no implicit historical registry. A null or omitted custom challenge set retains legacy seeded gap-only generation.
rules.limits: Counter increments checked before Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1. Object window stays local; no accumulated distance coordinate. Unsupported custom configs are experiments, not guaranteed reachable.

reactionEvidence.evidence: All 26 selectable family edges crossed with real Step physics at prior-exit entry states y offsets -5000/0/5000 and vertical velocities -500/0/500 after holding the previous lane for 18 ticks. A separate 64-seed, 5000-tick controller corpus survives and observes all 26 edges. This is bounded controller-specific evidence, not a universal or human latest-action guarantee; playtest acceptance remains open.

reachabilityWitness.controller: bounded custom-physics long-run controller only; not a default-feasibility claim
reachabilityWitness.note: Default gaps vary and require active steering; custom witness does not prove default or arbitrary-config reachability.
